title: Deliveries and returns
description: What is due to arrive, what you hire and what has to go back. The received quantity is recorded once; after that it changes only through a correction with a reason.

empty.title: No deliveries yet
empty.body: Add the first delivery — the hired chairs, the flowers, the cake — with the day, the slot and where it arrives.
empty.bodyReadOnly: When the planner adds deliveries, you will see them here and can record what arrived.

fields.title: What is delivered
fields.titleHint: For example: chairs and tables, flower arrangements.
fields.placeHint: For example: the back entrance, at the kitchen.
fields.itemLabelHint: For example: chairs. You can add more afterwards.
fields.depositHint: Only for hired items. Leave it empty if there is none.

correct.title: Correct the received quantity
correct.intro: {label}: {current} is on record now. The correction keeps the old value, the new value, who corrected it and why.
correct.reasonHint: For example: I counted again, two were in the second van.
correct.introReturn: {label}: {current} is on record as returned. The correction keeps the old value, the new value, who corrected it and why.

return.title: Record the return
return.intro: {label}: {received} were received. Write how many went back.

deposit.undoIntro: The recovered deposit stays in the history. Write why you are correcting it.

remove.title: Delete the delivery?
remove.body: “{title}” disappears from the plan, together with its items.

errors.quantity: Write the quantity in digits, for example 120.
errors.amount: Write the amount in digits, for example 500 or 1.500,50.
errors.supplier: Choose a supplier of this occasion.
errors.slotOrder: The end time must be after the start time.
errors.dayForTime: Choose the day for the times you wrote.
errors.time: Write the time in the format 14:30.
errors.hasFacts: Quantities have already been recorded. A delivery with recorded receipts can no longer be deleted.
errors.useCorrection: The received quantity is already on record. Use “Correct the received quantity”.
errors.useCorrectionReturn: The return is already on record. Use “Correct the returned quantity”.
errors.nothingToCorrect: Nothing has been recorded yet to correct.
errors.sameQuantity: This is already the quantity on record. Write the correct value.
